steps.title: Prepare cell culture
steps.instruction: Culture FreeStyle™ HEK293F cells at 37 °C in FreeStyle™ 293 Expression Medium.

steps.title: Seed cells for transfection
steps.instruction: The day before transfection, seed cells at a density of 0.7 × 10⁶ cells · mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Prepare DNA and PEI solutions
steps.instruction: Dilute 400 µg endotoxin‑free plasmid DNA (encoding 3XFLAG‑TEV‑ATG2A or variants) in 13 mL Opti‑MEM™; in parallel, dilute 800 µg PEI 25K in another 13 mL Opti‑MEM™.

steps.title: Form DNA‑PEI complexes and add to cells
steps.instruction: Combine the DNA and PEI mixtures, incubate 15 min at room temperature, then add dropwise to a 400 mL HEK293F culture.

steps.title: Supplement culture post‑transfection
steps.instruction: 24 h after transfection, add 100 mL EX‑CELL® 293 Serum‑Free Medium to the culture.

steps.title: Harvest cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: 72 h after transfection, centrifuge the culture at 270 × g, 4 °C, for 20 min.

steps.title: Wash and freeze cell pellets
steps.instruction: Wash the cell pellet once with PBS, flash‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Thaw pellets and resuspend in lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen pellets on ice and resuspend in 20 mL lysis buffer (add OG from a 10 % stock in water, CMC ≈ 0.6 % to aid solubilisation).

steps.title: Lyse cells with Dounce homogenizer
steps.instruction: Gently pipette the suspension, then perform mechanical lysis with a Dounce homogenizer: 10 strokes with the loose pestle followed by two rounds of 20 strokes with the tight pestle.

steps.title: Incubate lysate on ice
steps.instruction: Incubate the lysate on ice for 20–30 min.

steps.title: Clarify lysate by high‑speed centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 15 000 rpm, 4 °C, for 30 min; collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Bind protein to anti‑FLAG resin
steps.instruction: Incubate the cleared lysate with 0.6 mL pre‑equilibrated anti‑FLAG® M2 resin for 3 h at 4 °C with gentle rotation.

steps.title: Wash resin with glycerol‑containing buffer
steps.instruction: Wash the beads three times with 13 mL wash buffer that contains glycerol.

steps.title: Wash resin with glycerol‑free buffer
steps.instruction: Wash the beads three additional times with 13 mL wash buffer without glycerol.

steps.title: Final low‑volume wash for residual protein
steps.instruction: Wash the beads once with 150 µL wash buffer without glycerol to recover residual protein (Elution 2).

steps.title: Transfer resin to microcentrifuge tubes
steps.instruction: Move the washed beads into 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Elute protein with TEV or FLAG peptide
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL wash buffer without glycerol containing 5 µL TEV protease per tube; alternatively, add 100 µL FLAG peptide (Sigma‑Aldrich catalog #F3290‑4MG) at 4 mg · mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Incubate eluate overnight
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes overnight at 4 °C with gentle agitation.

steps.title: Collect and aliquot eluates
steps.instruction: Collect the eluate (Elution 1); combine with Elution 2, aliquot, snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Maintain cold conditions throughout
steps.instruction: Perform all steps at 4 °C or on ice to preserve protein stability.
